story-welcome-1.text: I am Moss. I keep the Count Book.

story-welcome-2.text: We had six buns. Now we have five.

story-welcome-3.text: The count is wrong. It makes us muddled.

story-welcome-4.text: Pick a pal. Go and help.

ui-gateClosed.text:
The gate is shut.
Help the pals on the path.

ui-gateSoon.text: A new path will come soon.

story-ring-2.text: A bun sat here. Now it is gone.

story-ring-3.text: Who made the ring? Odd. Very odd.

story-den-0.text: Look! A den behind the falls.

story-den-1.text: Ring marks. All over the walls.

story-den-2.text: And a page from the Count Book!

story-den-3.text: It counts past nine. Ten. Eleven. Twelve.

story-den-4.text: Why did the counts stop at nine?

story-falls-0.text: Hoo! You made it to Twin Falls.

story-falls-1.text: We have two of everything here.

story-falls-2.text: Two falls. Two trees. Two big rocks.

story-falls-3.text: But our counts come out wrong too.

story-falls-4.text: Help my pals. Then look for clues.

story-mist-1.text: A round shape, in the mist.

story-mist-2.text: It looks at us. It looks sad.

story-mist-4.text: It is gone. We must find it.
